title.en: Architect assistant: from requirements to A/B testing
title.zh-CN: 架构助手：从需求到 A/B 实验

description.en: Follow an elder-care AI application from a new conversation through architecture, deployment, evaluation, and a complete configuration-bundle A/B experiment. Includes real scores, trace investigation, and resource cleanup.
description.zh-CN: 以老人陪伴 AI 应用为例，从新建会话、梳理需求到方案部署、一键评估，再完成一次配置包 A/B 实验。包含真实评分、追踪排查、实验结论与资源清理。

title.en: Agent Management: create, maintain, and validate
title.zh-CN: Agent 管理：创建、维护与运行验证

description.en: Tour the live Agent Management console: creation methods, model and capability configuration, agent filtering, deployment logs, AWS versions and endpoints, Harness-to-Runtime conversion, resource discovery, external ownership, system presets, and a real Chat Playground invocation. Configuration and lifecycle actions are explained without submitting new deployments or deletions.
description.zh-CN: 实录 Agent 管理模块：创建方式、模型与能力配置、列表筛选、部署日志、AWS 版本与端点、Harness 转换、资源发现、外部资源与系统预置，以及一次真实对话验证。配置和维护入口以审阅讲解为主，不提交新部署或删除。
